name: @acme/kit
description: A hand-written installed package for the engine tests: the standoff feature and a spacer part
author: Acme Robotics

meta.label: Standoff
meta.description: A boss with a bore through it, standing on a planar face

face.label: On face
face.description: Exactly one planar face to stand on. The standoff is centred on the face's centre and grows along its normal, so pick a face sized for one standoff, such as a raised pad's top (pad.endFaces()).

height.label: Height
height.description: How far the standoff rises from the face, along its normal: the gap the board sits above the face.

outer.label: Boss diameter
outer.description: The outside diameter of the cylindrical boss. Must be larger than hole.

hole.label: Hole diameter
hole.description: The diameter of the bore, always through the boss's full height: about 3.2 for an M3 clearance hole, 2.5 for an M3 thread-forming screw. Must be smaller than outer.
